# Sillon

> A self-hosted Next.js app that lays your saved Spotify albums and liked songs on a calendar, grouped by the day you added them. Its repository was named spotify-calendar until November 2026.

Each day of the calendar shows the covers saved that day; the library can be read by month, week or day, as a year drawn like a record (one groove per month, one dot per day with saves), as a journal or as stats; a "drop the needle" button opens a random day, and each day recalls what was saved around the same date a year before. It can be filtered by search, release year and artist, and played on your Spotify devices. Authentication runs server-side (Authorization Code flow): Spotify tokens live in httpOnly cookies and never reach the browser. It is self-hosted — a Docker image on your own machine (`make up` for development, `make prod-deploy` for the standalone image), with your own Spotify app's credentials — and a deployment can be shared, every stored piece of data being keyed by the Spotify account that produced it. `DEMO_MODE=1` runs it over a fixture library with no Spotify account. Free software under the MIT licence; not affiliated with Spotify.

## Showcase

- [Sillon showcase](https://costardrouge.github.io/sillon/): the landing page, with screenshots of the real interface taken over a demo library of real releases with invented save dates
- [Legal notice](https://costardrouge.github.io/sillon/#legal): who publishes the showcase, who hosts it, and what it knows about a visitor (visits counted anonymously with a self-hosted Umami at insight.steevepommier.com, no cookie, declinable through Do Not Track, Global Privacy Control or a switch on the notice)
